;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**Officials say that an attack by the [[Taliban]] on an army outpost killed 10 soldiers and 7 policemen in [[Khwaja Ghar District]] after 7 policemen were killed in [[Farah, Afghanistan|Farah]] yesterday. [https://www.fresnobee.com/news/nation-world/world/article221402880.html (AP via ''The Fresno Bee'')]
*[[2018 Melbourne stabbing attack]]
**One person is killed and two others are injured  by a knife-wielding man  in  [[Melbourne]], Australia. The suspect, a 31-year-old Australian resident originally from [[Somalia]], randomly stabbed pedestrians after exiting his burning, crashed utility truck that held multiple gas canisters. He was shot and killed attempting to stab responding police. The [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant]] claims responsibility. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/suspect-shot-fatal-stabbing-australia-police/story?id=59078462 (ABC News)] [https://www.theage.com.au/national/victoria/the-bourke-street-incident-what-we-know-so-far-20181109-p50f5h.html (''The Age'')]  [https://www.npr.org/2018/11/09/666045929/3-stabbed-1-dead-in-australia-in-incident-police-say-is-possible-terrorism (NPR)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Camp Fire (2018)|Camp Fire]], [[2018 California wildfires]] 
**At least 11 people have been killed and more than 150,000 evacuated as two big wildfires rage in [[California]], the [[Camp Fire (2018)|Camp Fire]] in [[Butte County, California|Butte County]] and the Hill Fire in [[Ventura, California|Ventura]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-46161280 (BBC)]
*Flash floods caused by heavy rain in [[Petra]], [[Jordan]], kill 11 people while 24 others are injured. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-46161276 (BBC)]
*Two additional bodies are found in the rubble of the two buildings that collapsed four days ago in [[Marseille]], [[France]], bringing the final death toll to eight. [https://www.lci.fr/amp/police/marseille-qui-sont-les-victimes-de-l-effondrement-des-deux-immeubles-rue-d-aubagne-noailles-2103875.html (LCI)]
*A convoy accident involving [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|British Prime Minister]] [[Theresa May]] and [[Prime Minister of Belgium|Belgian Prime Minister]] [[Charles Michel]] interrupts an [[Armistice Day]] trip after two police motorbikes were knocked over. [https://news.sky.com/story/theresa-mays-convoy-accident-interrupts-armistice-day-trip-11549212 (Sky News)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ww1-century-accident/convoy-carrying-british-belgian-pms-hit-by-car-media-idUSKCN1NE1J6?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime 
*Former [[Philippines|Philippine]] [[First Lady or First Gentleman of the Philippines|First Lady]] and [[Ilocos Norte]] [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|Representative]] [[Imelda Marcos]] has been convicted on seven counts of [[Graft (politics)|graft]] for transferring funds to private foundations in [[Switzerland]] and is sentenced to at least six years and one month [[imprisonment]] for each count. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/216289-imelda-marcos-guilty-of-graft-sandiganbayan-orders-arrest (''Rappler'')] [https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/2172422/imelda-marcos-widow-philippine-dictator-facing-arrest-and (''South China Morning Post'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[United States Senate election in Florida, 2018]]
**As the Florida Senate election heads to a mandatory recount, [[United States President]] [[Donald Trump]] and [[Rick Scott]] claim, without evidence, that widespread voter fraud occurred in [[Florida]] during the [[United States elections, 2018|recent midterm election]]. [https://www.npr.org/2018/11/09/666018707/trump-scott-spread-claims-of-voter-fraud-as-florida-race-narrows (NPR)]
**State judges order election officials from [[Broward County, Florida|Broward]] and [[Palm Beach County, Florida|Palm Beach]] Counties to release absentee ballot information as they continue to count the ballots. [https://www.winknews.com/2018/11/09/judges-rule-in-favor-of-scott-election-lawsuits/ (WINK News)]
*[[List of executive actions by Donald Trump]], [[List of lawsuits involving Donald Trump]]
**The [[American Civil Liberties Union]] files a lawsuit in response to President Trump's proclamation that denies asylum to immigrants who enter the country illegally. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2018/11/09/donald-trump-migrant-caravan-aclu-federal-court-immigration-immigration-border-central-americans/1940528002/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[Opposition to Brexit in the United Kingdom]]
**[[Member of parliament#United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland|British MP]] [[Jo Johnson]] resigns as transport minister over [[Theresa May]]'s [[Brexit]] plan and calls for a [[People's Vote|second referendum]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2018/nov/09/jo-johnson-quits-as-minister-over-theresa-mays-brexit-plan-boris (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-46155403 (BBC)]
*[[2018 Sri Lankan constitutional crisis]]
